:::{#exm-contrapositive}
#### The contrapositive versus the converse

The [proposition](#def-proposition) "if $n$ is a multiple of $4$, then $n$ is even"
from @exm-converse has:

- converse (@def-converse): "if $n$ is even, then $n$ is a multiple of $4$", which is false;
- contrapositive (@def-contrapositive): "if $n$ is not even, then $n$ is not a multiple of $4$",
  which is true, by @thm-contrapositive,
  because the original proposition is true.

:::
